propositions: The packaged code-review guide at src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md lines 112–114 contains stale instructions that incorrectly tell contributors to ping a maintainer when a coverage-gap block occurs, rather than documenting the self-service recheck-review trigger.

Ticket bb9b introduced contributor-triggerable re-review via the 'recheck-review' comment on Gerrit changes, which was merged and deployed to production (Gerrit change 1243), but the packaged guide was not updated.
The guide is the primary discoverable on-ramp for contributors and is directly referenced in AGENTS.md, making its stale text actively misdirecting users away from the self-service solution.

The coverage-gap bullet must be updated to name recheck-review as the self-service re-trigger and clarify that recheck-review mirrors recheck (CI), consistent with CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/review-policy.md.
